# Audit Log Events

<!-- Generated by Oli.Auditing.EventReference. Do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Regenerate: MIX_ENV=test mix run test/support/audit_log_event_reference.exs -->

Reference for every event stored in `audit_log_events`. Families, labels, and descriptions
live in `Oli.Auditing.EventCatalog` (code), not in the database. Each example shows the
columns an event sets; omitted columns are `NULL`, `{}`, or `[]`.

## Columns

| Column | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Row identifier from `audit_events_id_seq`. Unique together with `inserted_at`. |
| `inserted_at` | When the row was recorded (UTC). Partition key; date filters and sorting use it. |
| `occurred_at` | When the action happened. Differs from `inserted_at` only for late-recorded async outcomes. `NULL` on migrated rows. |
| `schema_version` | `2` for events written by the application; `1` for migrated history whose unknown fields stay `NULL`. |
| `event_type` | What happened. One of the catalog names below. |
| `outcome` | Result: `succeeded`, `initiated`, `failed`, `canceled`, `partial`, `unknown`. |
| `actor_type` | Who acted: `user`, `author`, `system`; `unknown` only on migrated rows without an actor. |
| `actor_key` | System actor key when `actor_type` is `system`: `playwright_setup`, `provider_provisioning`, `scheduled_maintenance`. |
| `user_id` | Acting user, when the actor is a user. |
| `author_id` | Acting author, when the actor is an author. |
| `actor_snapshot` | Actor identity at the time: `id`, `name`, `email` for accounts; `key`, `label` for system actors. |
| `entity_type` | Kind of record the event is about, from the event contract. |
| `entity_id` | Identifier of that record as text: numeric ID, UUID, stable key, or composite such as `section:301/resource:4512/user:77`. |
| `entity_snapshot` | Identity of the record at the time (allowlisted fields only), readable after it is renamed or deleted. |
| `affected_user_id` | Learner or user the action was done to, when different from the actor's role in the event. |
| `affected_author_id` | Author the action was done to. |
| `project_id` | Project the event belongs to, whenever known. |
| `section_id` | Section, product, or blueprint the event belongs to, whenever known. |
| `resource_id` | Resource (page, assessment, container, objective) the event belongs to, whenever known. |
| `institution_id` | Institution the event belongs to, whenever known. |
| `refs` | Other related records as `{role, type, id, label}`; roles: `scope`, `source`, `previous`, `resulting`, `linked`, `provider`. |
| `changes` | Per-field records `{operation, before, after, ...}` limited to the contract's fields; secret fields only record `redacted: true`; at most 65536 bytes. |
| `details` | Extra facts limited to the contract's keys; at most 16384 bytes. |
| `source` | Where the change originated: `system`, `ui`, `api`, `mcp`, `job`, `scenario`, `application`. |
| `operation_id` | Command that produced the event; events of one bulk command share it. |
| `parent_operation_id` | Operation that spawned this one, such as the publish that started a publication-application job. |
| `event_key` | Deterministic slot of the event inside its operation, such as `exception:77:updated`. |
| `legacy_source` | Migrated rows only: source table (`audit_log_events` or `settings_changes`). |
| `legacy_id` | Migrated rows only: the row's ID in its source table. |
| `search_text` | Text indexed for search, built from snapshots and reference labels. |
| `search_vector` | Generated `tsvector` of `search_text` (`simple` configuration). |

## Families

| Family | Events |
| --- | --- |
| Authentication | `user_logged_in`, `author_logged_in`, `user_logged_out`, `author_logged_out`, `session_revoked` |
| Account | `account_created`, `account_updated`, `account_locked`, `account_unlocked`, `account_linked`, `account_permissions_changed`, `account_creation_rights_changed`, `account_recovery_requested`, `account_credential_recovered`, `user_deleted`, `author_deleted`, `author_role_changed`, `account_internal_flag_changed` |
| Project | `project_created`, `project_duplicated`, `project_imported`, `project_deleted`, `project_ownership_changed`, `project_collaborator_changed`, `project_published` |
| Assessment settings | `assessment_settings_changed`, `assessment_settings_reset`, `assessment_setting_changed` |
| Student exceptions | `student_exception_created`, `student_exception_updated`, `student_exception_deleted` |
| DOT and activation points | `dot_settings_changed`, `activation_settings_changed`, `instructor_ai_recommendation_changed` |
| Remix | `section_remix_saved` |
| Destructive content | `authoring_content_removed`, `authoring_content_replaced`, `bank_question_deleted`, `media_deleted`, `google_doc_imported` |
| Discussion | `discussion_post_deleted`, `discussion_thread_deleted`, `discussion_moderated` |
| Learner intervention | `resource_attempt_deleted`, `learner_attempt_reset`, `learner_progress_restored`, `manual_grade_changed`, `learner_regraded` |
| Project settings | `project_settings_changed` |
| Authoring configuration | `authoring_settings_changed`, `learning_objectives_changed`, `curriculum_changed` |
| Section lifecycle and settings | `section_created`, `section_deleted`, `section_archived`, `section_settings_changed`, `product_created`, `product_deleted`, `product_archived`, `product_settings_changed`, `blueprint_created`, `blueprint_deleted`, `blueprint_archived`, `blueprint_settings_changed` |
| Enrollment and access | `invitation_created`, `invitation_accepted`, `enrollment_changed`, `instructor_access_changed` |
| Publication application | `publication_applied`, `publication_update_policy_changed` |
| Gating and scheduling | `gating_changed`, `prerequisite_changed`, `curriculum_schedule_changed` |
| Support configuration | `discussion_settings_changed`, `notes_settings_changed`, `student_support_settings_changed` |
| Payments | `payment_settings_changed`, `pricing_changed`, `discount_changed`, `payment_code_administered`, `entitlement_changed` |
| Certificates | `certificate_settings_changed`, `certificate_granted`, `certificate_revoked` |
| Organizations | `institution_settings_changed`, `community_settings_changed`, `publisher_settings_changed`, `research_consent_settings_changed` |
| Integrations | `lms_settings_changed`, `sso_settings_changed`, `lti_settings_changed`, `external_tool_settings_changed`, `roster_settings_changed`, `grade_passback_settings_changed` |
| AI and credentials | `ai_service_settings_changed`, `credential_lifecycle_changed` |
| Feature flags | `feature_flag_enabled`, `feature_flag_disabled`, `feature_flag_removed`, `feature_rollout_stage_changed`, `feature_rollout_stage_deleted`, `feature_rollout_exemption_upserted`, `feature_rollout_exemption_deleted` |
| Administrative operations | `administrative_operation`, `clickhouse_admin_operation_initiated`, `clickhouse_admin_operation_outcome` |
| Preferences | `preferences_changed` |

## Authentication

### `user_logged_in`

**User logged in.** A learner or instructor account started an authenticated session.

| Rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Actors | `user` |
| Entity types | `user`, `author` |
| Required columns | none |
| At least one of | none |
| Affected person | `user`, `author` (required; equals the entity) |
| Outcomes | `succeeded` |
| No-op policy | `lifecycle` (written without changes) |
| Change fields | none |
| Detail keys | `auth_method`, `session_ref`, `revoked_count` |
| Reference roles | none |
| Status | active |

Example:

```json

}
```
